fragen.frage: Can I return boots that don't fit?
fragen.antworttext: Yes. Boots can be returned if they meet the return conditions: all labels are still attached, the item is clean and dry, any waterproof membrane is unmarked, and the item comes back with its stuff sack, poles, pegs or straps where these were part of the original delivery. Boots cannot be returned if they show sole wear. If boots are faulty, the faulty-item route applies instead. [returns-and-exchanges.md] [gear-care-and-repairs.md]

laeufe_einzeln.antworttext: Yes. Boots can be returned if they meet the return conditions: all labels are still attached, the item is clean and dry, any waterproof membrane is unmarked, and the item comes back with its stuff sack, poles, pegs or straps where these were part of the original delivery. Boots cannot be returned if they show sole wear. If boots are faulty, the faulty-item route applies instead. [returns-and-exchanges.md] [gear-care-and-repairs.md]

Yes, boots can be returned if they meet the return conditions: all labels must still be attached, the item must be clean and dry, any waterproof membrane must be unmarked, and the item must come back with its stuff sack, poles, pegs or straps where these were part of the original delivery. Boots cannot be returned if they show sole wear. [returns-and-exchanges.md]

Yes. Boots can be returned if they meet the return conditions: all labels are still attached, the item is clean and dry, and boots must not show sole wear. Boots that show sole wear are not accepted for return. [returns-and-exchanges.md]

Yes, boots can be returned if they meet the return conditions: all labels are still attached, the item is clean and dry, and the boots have not been worn in a way that shows sole wear. Boots that show sole wear cannot be returned. The source also says returns are accepted only when these conditions are met. Source: returns-and-exchanges.md

Yes. Boots can be returned if they meet the return conditions: all labels are still attached, the item is clean and dry, and boots must not show sole wear. Boots that show sole wear are not accepted as returns. [Source: returns-and-exchanges.md]

fragen.frage: How long do I have to return a jacket?
fragen.antworttext: You have 30 days to return a jacket from the day the parcel is delivered, not from the day the order is placed. Trail Club members at Ridge and Summit level have 100 days instead, and the longer window applies automatically when the order was placed while signed in to a member account. [returns-and-exchanges.md]
